mockups.title: Вариант 1 — Мастерская
mockups.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a polished original fantasy card-game COLLECTION / DECK EDITOR screen design concept for a Unity desktop game, landscape 16:9 at approximately 1920x1080. One flat complete screen, no monitor, no perspective, no hands, no montage. Input image 1 is the established CREATURE CARD FAMILY AND ART reference, input image 2 is the approved large creature card styling reference, input image 3 is the current FUNCTIONAL screen only, NOT its visual design to copy. Preserve the actual card silhouettes: portrait 0.70 ratio, circular power upper left, elemental badge upper right, dark title plaque, small type and rarity footer, colorful painted creatures. Use our fox, beetle, lagoon serpent, swift, stag, purple imp, phoenix, griffin, winged guardian, sea queen and stone titan artwork language. Do not substitute other games' cards, logos, names, icons or characters. Original hand-painted fantasy UI in dark teal stone, restrained bronze and warm ivory lettering, tactile broad clean bevels, clear large controls and strong reading hierarchy; no clutter or excessive ornaments. It must feel like a finished game screen, not gray wireframes and not a business dashboard.

CRITICAL GAME RULES: a deck has EXACTLY NINE cards, with THREE Fields, THREE Creatures, THREE Abilities. For each type there is one Common, one Epic and one Legendary. Never show 30 or 60 cards, mana curves, life totals, packs, shop, currencies or crafting. Selected deck is named "Лесной дозор", valid count "9 / 9". There may be MANY saved decks, show "12 колод", searchable and scrollable management, no three fixed preset tabs and no implied max of three. Card collection has "68 карт", creature filter has "18 карт". All interface text in Russian and clearly readable. Important controls: "Все", "Карты поля", "Существа", "Способности", "Поиск карт…", "Редкость", six small elemental filter icons, "Мои колоды", "+ Новая колода", "Играть с ИИ", and "В меню". Destructive actions are tucked into a small ellipsis context menu, never a prominent red delete button. A small "Сохранено" status reflects autosave. Active tabs use warm bronze edging and subdued teal glow, not neon.

For reference the selected valid nine-card deck can list these grouped cards: Fields: "Старый алтарь", "Зеркальное озеро", "Вечный маяк"; Creatures: "Лучистый олень", "Вихревой грифон", "Владыка Багрового Горна"; Abilities: "Благословение поля", "Вынужденное раскрытие", "Возврат силы". Single selected collection card can be "Каменный жук", Earth "Земля", power "135", Common "Обычная". Add action should imply replacing the matching slot, not adding a tenth card. Use only a few necessary labels rather than dense fake paragraphs. No watermark, no English, no mockup title outside the actual game UI. LAYOUT A — ALL-IN-ONE WORKSHOP. Warm dark carved wood outer surround, slate teal leather-like panels and restrained bronze trims. Three stable vertical columns with generous gutters. LEFT about 16 percent: heading "Мои колоды", small "12 колод", deck search, a vertical scroll list with small creature artwork thumbnails, six or seven visible named decks and a visible scrollbar implying more: selected "Лесной дозор", "Пламя горна", "Властители приливов", "Тень руин" with "8 / 9" draft marker, "Горный бастион", "Небесный страж", and a "+ Новая колода" button. CENTER about 60 percent: large collection area, title, search and type tabs, a row of elemental filters and rarity. Show a spacious FOUR by TWO grid of EIGHT genuine framed creature cards, not text rows, "Существа" active, "18 карт", pagination below. Cards should be the visual focus. RIGHT about 24 percent: selected deck name with pencil rename icon, "9 / 9", then exactly THREE grouped sections "Карты поля 3 / 3", "Существа 3 / 3", "Способности 3 / 3", each with three compact horizontal card rows with thumbnail and rarity dot. Bottom of right column: a compact selected card summary for Каменный жук and contextual "В колоду" button, helper "Заменит обычное существо", then a prominent "Играть с ИИ" button and small "Сохранено". Large full card inspection is on demand, not an extra permanent fourth column. This is a practical attractive fantasy workbench with fast access to many decks and the entire current deck visible.
